channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: A mentira da polarização: pesquisas mostram que há, sim, desejo por 3ª via
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll shows that 36% of voters prefer Lula, 32% would support any candidate endorsed by Jair Bolsonaro, and 27% favor a third-way option — someone not tied to either major pole. This reveals a notable appetite for alternatives beyond Brazil’s traditional two-sided polarization.

item.title: Governo e oposição chegam a acordo e abrem caminho para votação da MP do Frete
item.description: The government and opposition reached an agreement to enable the vote on the Freight MP in the Senate, aiming to prevent the measure from expiring on Thursday. The deal includes textual adjustments in four or five points and the retention of provisions the government opposes, which will be vetoed by Lula after congressional approval. Key points of contention are the amnesty for fines related to post-2022 blockades and the establishment of a minimum wage for truck drivers.

item.title: Lula repete Dilma e segura imposto da cerveja em ano de Copa
item.description: The Lula government has decided to maintain current beer taxation during the 2026 World Cup and presidential election year, following Dilma Rousseff’s 2014 strategy to avoid political backlash. The Finance Ministry plans to shift the tax burden to the new Selective Tax only in 2027, with a 'smooth transition,' postponing debate on progressive taxation of alcohol and tobacco until after the elections. The move benefits the beverage industry, which lobbies to preserve advantages from the old tax regime, despite Complementary Law 214 prohibiting tax rates from being tied to sector-specific revenue maintenance.

item.title: Dizer que Bolsonaro é perseguido só convence convertido, diz chefe de comunicação do PT
item.description: PT communications secretary Éden Valadares said the STF's decision to ban Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting Jair Bolsonaro should not be a concern, as the persecution narrative only convinces the already converted. He praised Minister Alexandre de Moraes' ruling, stating that sharing the letter via social media violated judicial orders and constituted an abuse of visitation rights.

item.title: Desembargador aposentado pede que Flávio "dê a mão" a Michelle e Zema
item.description: Retired judge and Senate pre-candidate Sebastião Coelho urged presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro to reach out to Michelle Bolsonaro and Romeu Zema to unite the right wing. He claimed that the STF minister Alexandre de Moraes' decision to suspend Flávio's visits to his father, Jair Bolsonaro, aims to disrupt right-wing articulations. Coelho recalled that Jair Bolsonaro called for unity and emphasized that the right cannot win elections without Michelle and Minas Gerais with Zema.

item.title: Lula tem 67% contra 24% de Flávio no 2º turno no Piauí, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Real Time Big Data poll shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leading with 67% of voting intentions in Piauí against 24% for Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential 2026 runoff. In the first round, Lula has 65% versus 20% for the senator. Flávio Bolsonaro is the most rejected candidate in the state with 58% rejection, while Lula’s government is approved by 67% of Piauí voters.

item.title: Aliados de Lula não querem revogação de prisão domiciliar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula's allies welcomed Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes' decision to ban Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest, viewing it as a correct enforcement of the social media restriction order. They hope Moraes will not revoke Bolsonaro's house arrest, as doing so would provide substantial political ammunition for the opposition in the 2026 election campaign. Petistas argue that while the visit ban is already being politicized by Bolsonaro's supporters, revoking the house arrest would be a 'golden platter' for opposition attacks.

item.title: Sob ameaça de tarifaço dos EUA, governo Lula trabalha com cenário desfavorável e prepara reação
item.description: The Lula government is preparing for an unfavorable outcome in which the U.S. imposes tariffs on Brazilian goods, despite public statements of confidence. Technical advisors believe the U.S. decision is politically driven and legally robust due to Section 301, making a technical victory unlikely. The government plans to turn the episode into an electoral asset by linking U.S. pressure to opposition actions, particularly those of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Após suspensão de visitas de Flávio ao pai, Eduardo Bolsonaro afirma que Moraes deveria ter Magnitsky restabelecida
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro criticized the suspension of visits between Flávio Bolsonaro and his father, Jair Bolsonaro, who is under house arrest, calling the measure politically motivated and suggesting the 2026 elections should not be recognized as democratic. He urged the reinstatement of Magnitsky sanctions against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, which were lifted by the U.S. in December 2024.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lula e família Bolsonaro 'jogam o mesmo jogo'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, pre-candidate for president from the PSD, criticized the polarization between Lula's government and the Bolsonaro bloc, stating both 'play the same game' by turning judicial and political disputes into central themes of the 2026 election, diverting attention from real issues like high interest rates, household debt, public security, and technological innovation. He advocated for spending cuts, administrative reform, greater state and municipal autonomy, and urged the campaign to focus on AI, productivity, and economic growth rather than who can speak with whom.

item.title: A pedido de Lula, PT aposta nas ruas e lança 1º Comitê Popular
item.description: The PT launched the first Popular Struggle Committee in Salvador (BA), responding to Lula’s call for greater social mobilization. The committee includes the participation of Minister of the General Secretariat of the Presidency, Guilherme Boulos, and is part of a national strategy to expand popular participation spaces in key states, starting with Bahia, which is considered strategic due to its PT-led government, Northeastern location, and strong tradition of social mobilization.

item.title: Vorcaro e Michelle fazem Flávio perder terreno para Lula nas redes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro lost ground to Lula on social media amid controversies involving Daniel Vorcaro and Michelle Bolsonaro. According to a DSC Lab survey, the senator retained the lead in the iBR index with 73.57 points but dropped 4.28 points from May. Meanwhile, Lula gained 9.51 points, reaching 55.28 — the highest monthly increase.

item.title: Pré-campanha de Flávio recalcula rota após proibição de Moraes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) pre-campaign for the Brazilian presidency was forced to recalibrate its strategy after Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes barred the senator from visiting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, until the October elections. PL sources told O Antagonista that the restriction directly undermines the campaign’s plan to leverage familial and symbolic support from the former president.

item.title: Caiado diz que Lula faz manobras "criminosas"e pedaladas na economia
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) accused President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) of committing 'criminal' maneuvers and 'fiscal pedaling' in the 2027 budget, citing TCU findings on unmet health targets and violations of the fiscal framework. Caiado stated that, if elected, he would implement budget cuts to ensure proper use of public funds without harming key sectors, and argued that fiscal balance is compatible with social dignity if paired with strong action against crime and corruption.

item.title: Renan Santos aposta em aplicativo para atrair eleitores
item.description: Renan Santos, the pré-candidate of the Missão party for President of Brazil, will launch an AI-powered mobile app to mobilize his grassroots supporters and strengthen his campaign. The platform will feature point-based rankings for completing activist challenges, daily missions (such as recruiting three new supporters), videos of his speeches, and a support channel to counter attacks — all designed to leverage technology to overcome financial disadvantages.

item.title: Futura/Apex: Lula tem 46% de aprovação e 49,7% de desaprovação a três meses de eleição
item.description: Lula has a 46% approval rating and 49.7% disapproval three months before the first round of the 2026 elections, according to a Futura/Apex poll. The figures suggest a technical tie within the margin of error.

item.title: França x Espanha na Copa: horário, onde assistir e escalações
item.description: France and Spain will face off on Tuesday, July 14, at 4:00 p.m. Brasília time, at Dallas Stadium in the USA, in the 2026 World Cup semifinal. The match will be exclusively broadcast by CazéTV, with refereeing by Iván Barton of El Salvador. The winner will advance to face either England or Argentina in the final.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro empatam em simulação de 2º turno, aponta pesquisa Futura/Apex
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are technically tied in a simulated second round of the 2026 presidential election, according to a Futura/Apex poll. The president has 46.3% of voting intentions, while the senator has 46.1%, within the margin of error. The survey reflects a highly competitive race between Brazil’s two main political poles.

item.title: Vídeo bomba de Michelle alcança engajamento 132% maior nas redes que carta aberta de Bolsonaro, aponta Nexus
item.description: A video released by Michelle Bolsonaro generated 132% more engagement on social media than the open letter from Jair Bolsonaro read by Flávio Bolsonaro, according to Nexus analysis. While the letter aimed to mobilize support for revoking the former president’s house arrest, Michelle’s video achieved greater digital reach and impact. The article is subscriber-only and highlights increasing polarization on social media surrounding the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: “Imparáveis” não é político nem foi criado por Michelle, diz movimento
item.description: The "Imparáveis" movement posted an Instagram note stating it is not a political movement and was not created by Michelle Bolsonaro. According to the statement, the profile was created by former members of PL Mulher's communications team, and Michelle only follows the account without administering or owning it. The movement describes itself as a blend of fandom inspired by Michelle Bolsonaro and a digital mobilization cluster.

item.title: Futura/Apex: Lula e Flávio têm empate técnico em segundo turno
item.description: The Futura/Apex poll released on July 14 shows a technical tie between Lula (46.3%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (46.1%) in a potential 2026 presidential runoff, with a mere 0.2-point difference within the 2-point margin of error. Flávio gained 3.2 points since June, while Lula dropped 1.8 points. In first-round scenarios, Lula leads consistently, with Flávio as the closest challenger in all simulations.

item.title: Desobediência, veto de Moraes e farsa: o novo round do clã com o STF
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro deliberately violated a STF precautionary measure by publicizing a letter from his father, Jair Bolsonaro, calling for unity on the right, resulting in a 90-day visitation ban. According to João Bosco Rabello, this is part of a calculated strategy by the Bolsonaro clan to weaponize judicial reactions for political gain, fueling a persecution narrative and bolstering Flávio's candidacy amid internal conflict with Michelle Bolsonaro and eroding far-right support. Comparisons by figures like Bia Kicis, Rogério Marinho, and Sérgio Moro to Lula's 2018 arrest are deemed false parallels aimed at discrediting the STF.

item.title: STF é desaprovado por 52,3% e aprovado por 35,9%, diz pesquisa
item.description: The Futura/Apex poll released in July 2026 shows that 52.3% of Brazilians disapprove of the Supreme Federal Court's (STF) performance, compared to 35.9% who approve, with 11.8% undecided. The survey, conducted between July 7 and 11 with 2,000 respondents nationwide, has a margin of error of ±2.2 percentage points and a 95% confidence level, and is registered with the TSE under BR-07294/2026. Funded by Futura Intelligence — acquired by Apex Partners in 2022 — the study reflects growing public dissatisfaction with the judiciary.

item.title: Congresso é desaprovado por 61,4% e aprovado por 26,2%, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Futura/Apex poll shows 61.4% of Brazilians disapprove of Congress's performance, while only 26.2% approve, with 12.4% unsure or not responding. Conducted from July 7–11, 2026 among 2,000 respondents, the survey has a 2.2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. It is registered with the TSE under BR-07294/2026 and was funded by Futura, acquired by Apex Partners in 2022.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 49,7% e aprovado por 46,0%, diz pesquisa
item.description: Lula has 49.7% disapproval and 46.0% approval in the Futura/Apex poll released on July 14, 2026, with 4.4% undecided. Government evaluation shows 38.6% rating it "good" or "excellent," 17.7% "fair," and 42.9% "poor" or "terrible." The survey interviewed 2,000 people nationwide from July 7–11, 2026, with a 2.2 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Lula e Flávio empatam no 2º turno, diz Futura/Apex
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are technically tied in a potential 2026 presidential runoff, with 46.3% and 46.1% voting intentions, respectively, according to the Futura/Apex poll. The survey also simulated runoffs between Lula and other candidates such as Ronaldo Caiado, Romeu Zema, Renan Santos, and Michelle Bolsonaro, and evaluated first-round scenarios, rejection, and approval ratings of institutions.

item.title: Lula não avança e a oposição segue pulverizada, mostram as pesquisas
item.description: Polls show Lula stagnant at 41% in first-round vote intentions, while his opponents collectively reach 48%, with both facing record and persistent rejection. Despite a fragmented opposition, it remains united enough to block Lula’s first-round victory, making a runoff likely. Party focus on legislative races weakens PT engagement in key states such as São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Visita de Flávio Bolsonaro a prefeito incomoda PL do Rio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's visit to Duque de Caxias Mayor Netinho Reis caused discomfort within the Rio de Janeiro PL, as Netinho is the nephew of Washington Reis, a key ally of Eduardo Paes (PSD), Bolsonaro's opponent in the state race. Party leaders criticized the lack of prior notice, calling the meeting inappropriate given the Reis family's support for the opposing ticket. Bolsonaro's allies downplayed the controversy, emphasizing the Reis family's pledged support for his presidential campaign.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that President Jair Bolsonaro will place the presidential sash on him in January 2026, predicting a familial succession to the presidency. He made the remark after assisting his father in defying a judicial order prohibiting political speech, declaring the scene would be witnessed 'in the name of Jesus'.

item.title: ALGUÉM CONSEGUE VENCER LULA HOJE? | O cenário real das pesquisas
item.description: The video examines whether anyone can defeat Lula in the 2026 elections, analyzing current polling trends. It notes that despite wear and criticism, Lula maintains a significant lead over main adversaries like Bolsonaro and other opposition figures, due to relative economic stability and support from key voter segments. The analysis suggests that defeating him today would be a considerable challenge without a drastic shift in the political or economic landscape.

item.title: Flávio diz que Bolsonaro é perseguido e um homem censurado
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) used X to defend former President Jair Bolsonaro, calling him 'unjustly treated, persecuted, and a censored man', following a 90-day suspension of his visits by Minister Alexandre de Moraes. He shared a video praising his father’s personal and political conduct, citing examples such as eating pastel with sugarcane juice and not using a corporate card during the presidency, and appealed for supporter mobilization. The post came one day after Moraes’ decision, which referenced a political letter read by Flávio in which Bolsonaro endorses his son as a pre-candidate and 'spokesperson'.

item.title: Lula já criticou Trump pelo menos 62 vezes em 3 anos e meio
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) has criticized former U.S. President Donald Trump in at least 62 instances since the start of his third term in January 2023. Criticisms intensified in 2026 following U.S. designation of Brazilian criminal factions as terrorist organizations and threats to impose new trade tariffs on Brazil. Lula’s most recent remark came on July 13, 2026, when he labeled Trump’s proposal to charge 20% for ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz as 'piracy'.

item.title: Congresso deve livrar Lula de um grande problema nesta terça
item.description: The Senate is set to vote on Tuesday on the Freight Provisional Measure following an agreement between the government, opposition, and truckers’ representatives, aiming to avert a strike that could harm President Lula ahead of the 2026 elections. The bill includes textual adjustments and signals possible presidential vetoes, including one on amnesty for fines related to post-2022 election protests, a provision introduced by Deputy Zé Trovão. Approval of the measure is expected to prevent the truckers’ strike.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro leva à Justiça quem está ligando o seu nome ao Comando Vermelho
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) filed a criminal complaint in Federal Court against Francisca Raquel Luz of Fortaleza, accusing her of defamation and insult for linking his name to the Red Command in an Instagram profile called 'Felino Sem Filtro'. The post in question was made in May 2024 and prompted the legal action by the son of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Charge do Aroeira
item.description: The Aroeira cartoon, published on Noblat's Blog, critiques the strategic silence and political missteps of Jair Bolsonaro and his son, suggesting their actions have been self-sabotaging. It also notes Lula's potential to capitalize on the apparent neutrality of the Centrão to advance his agenda. The piece blends political satire with references to other blog articles, maintaining an ironic tone toward Brazil's electoral landscape.

item.title: Fim da 6x1 completa 2 meses parado no Senado e sem calendário definido
item.description: The PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule has been stalled in the Senate for nearly two months, without referral to the CCJ or a set voting date. Approved by the Chamber of Deputies on May 27, the proposal reduces the weekly workweek from 44 to 40 hours and guarantees two paid rest days. The delay has heightened tensions between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and the Lula government, which treats the issue as a key social banner for reelection.

item.title: PL busca estratégias para Flávio após desgastes com carta de Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes barred Senator Flávio Bolsonaro from visiting imprisoned former President Jair Bolsonaro for 90 days, disrupting the PL's presidential campaign. The restriction cuts off Flávio's access to his father's political guidance during a critical phase of state alliance formation, though some allies argue the groundwork is already laid and Flávio has autonomy. The PL's national convention is set for July 25 in São Paulo.

item.title: O silêncio burlado e o tiro no pé dos Bolsonaro, pai e filho
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro, whose political rights are suspended following a definitive conviction by the STF, designated his son Flávio as his 'official spokesperson' in a letter published last Saturday, attempting to bypass the imposed silence in violation of the law. The move has been labeled a 'self-inflicted wound,' as it constitutes illegal early electioneering and has already prompted Minister Alexandre de Moraes to ban Flávio from visiting his father for 90 days and refer the matter to the Electoral Public Ministry. Flávio's PL presidential nomination, set for formalization on July 25, faces mounting risk due to this desperate strategy and accumulated political missteps.

item.title: Com ação de caminhoneiros, Senado é pressionado a analisar MP do Frete
item.description: The Senate is set to debate the Freight MP, which establishes a national minimum wage for truckers, following a strike by the category. Senate President Davi Alcolumbre is expected to meet with the government to enable a vote before the July 16 deadline. The preliminary agreement keeps the minimum wage concept but removes the fixed R$5,000 amount, leaving its definition for future regulation.

item.title: Nunes Marques se reúne com empresas de pesquisa no TSE para diálogo
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques will meet with polling companies to discuss electoral survey methodologies following the suspension of the AtlasIntel poll due to suspicions of voter induction. The case involved a question referencing alleged contact between Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro for financing a film about Jair Bolsonaro, immediately followed by a voting intention question. Minister Dias Toffoli emphasized the need for the TSE to establish objective parameters to assess what constitutes undue influence in polls.

item.title: As críticas de Lula a Nunes Marques após conversa regada a uísque
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques sought to approach President Lula to support the appointment of his ally Henrique Gouveia da Cunha as a judge at the TRF-1, during a conversation that included whiskey brought by the magistrate. The effort, however, was unsuccessful, according to a subscriber-only report.

item.title: Foto de vice-presidente do PT ao lado de adversário da sigla no Maranhão eleva crise interna no estado
item.description: The presence of national PT vice-president Rubens Pereira Júnior at an event with Eduardo Braide (PSD), the pre-candidate for Maranhão governor and an internal party adversary, caused discomfort among PT leaders. The party officially supports Felipe Camarão as its gubernatorial candidate, following pressure from allies of Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino, but internal divisions persist over whether to pursue an alliance with Braide or adopt a dual strategy supporting both Camarão and Orleans Brandão (MDB), the governor’s nephew.

item.title: Após veto a visitas de Flávio e sem poder contar com Michelle, defesa deve fazer ponte entre Bolsonaro e campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is barred from visiting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, by a decision of Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who views the disclosure of a letter from the ex-president as an improper use of visitation rights to circumvent the ban on social media use. Without Michelle Bolsonaro’s support and facing risks of communication noise through intermediaries, the campaign plans to rely on Jair Bolsonaro’s legal team as a communication channel, even if this makes the dialogue less direct.

item.title: Renan Santos envereda pelo rock como Milei e ironiza fama de machista: 'Mulheres são protagonistas nas minhas músicas'
item.description: Renan Santos, a pre-candidate for the Missão party and a declared admirer of Javier Milei, seeks to emulate the Argentine outsider’s style but criticizes Milei’s presidential band as musically 'tacky'. He fronts the rock band Limão Rosa under the alias 'Antônio Ferreira', having released their debut album 'Chão Pintado de Rubi' in São Paulo, with performances at Bar Alto in Vila Madalena. Despite the approaching campaign, Renan avoided political discussion during the shows, focusing on music and audience engagement.

item.title: Decisão de Moraes desafia campanha de Flávio ao cortar 'linha direta' com Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was judicially barred by Alexandre de Moraes from visiting his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest for 90 days. The ruling cuts off the direct communication line between father and son throughout the first-round campaign, hindering PL’s political articulations. The measure may undermine Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign strategy.

item.title: Bolsonaristas da Bahia utilizam críticas de Caiado a Flávio para pressionar ACM Neto por palanque
item.description: Bahia PL members are using Ronaldo Caiado's criticisms of Flávio Bolsonaro to pressure ACM Neto into supporting Bolsonaro's son in the first round, overriding the initial plan to back Caiado. The move aims to overcome Flávio's struggle to secure Northeastern support, leveraging Caiado's remarks comparing the senator to a 'Christmas turkey' being nurtured by Lula. Behind the scenes, there is an agreement for ACM Neto to back Caiado in the first round and consider a Flávio alliance only in a potential second-round runoff against Lula.

item.title: MG: especialistas apontam irregularidade em doação de bens de palácio
item.description: Experts indicate possible irregularities in the donation of 63 decorative furniture items from the Palácio das Mangabeiras to the State General Secretariat, without specifying which objects were transferred, raising suspicions about the disappearance of historical assets. The opposition has appealed to the TCE-MG and Federal Police, citing potential crimes against public property involving Romeu Zema and Mateus Simões. The government claims all assets were inventoried and internally redistributed, but an ALMG inspection found missing books, furniture, paintings, and historical objects.

item.title: Após operação da PF, governo de SP suspende consignados do Digimais
item.description: São Paulo's government, led by Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), temporarily suspended Banco Digimais' authorization to offer payroll-deductible loans to state servants, days after a Federal Police operation (Operation Miragem) seized up to R$670 million in assets and broke banking and fiscal secrecy of the bank's owners. The suspension relies on 'extreme urgency' legislation, despite the same digital government secretary having authorized Digimais in June 2025 — including for military police, granting access to over 80,000 agents. The move draws opposition criticism over alleged institutional favoritism due to ties between the Universal Church, Digimais, and the Republicanos party.

item.title: Como sobrevivem os partidos que não recebem Fundo Partidário: doações, filiados e outras receitas bancam gastos
item.description: Nine Brazilian parties survive almost without the Party Fund, relying on donations, member contributions and other revenues to finance their activities. DC was the highest earner among them, with R$ 2.8 million in 2025, nearly all from individual donations, while Mobiliza and PRTB spent more than they raised. PSTU relied primarily on member contributions, which accounted for 75% of its revenue.

item.title: Presidente do TSE reúne institutos de pesquisa para tratar de critérios de levantamentos eleitorais nesta terça-feira
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques is meeting with electoral research institutes on Tuesday to discuss criteria for conducting and publishing voter intention polls, aiming to prevent data contamination and judicial disputes. The meeting follows the May suspension of an AtlasIntel poll and seeks to establish guidelines on technology, verbal neutrality, and digital research flow, with most institutes represented by a lawyer from ABEP.
